prompt: Animate THIS EXACT approved creature, preserving its silhouette, anatomy, carved ivory mask, braided wood limbs, turquoise cloth with gold trim, amber eye and green leaves. Create a PRODUCTION TRANSPARENT sprite sheet: exactly FOUR equal columns and SEVEN equal rows = 28 frames. Tall 4:7 canvas. No text, labels, grid, borders, shadows outside the creature, projectiles, particles, or baked flash. Fixed side camera facing RIGHT. SAME PHYSICAL SCALE in every cell. Generous empty gutters, nothing touches cell boundaries. Fixed horizontal body anchor; a common floor at 85% of every cell (for flyer common flight center). Same detailed pixel clusters as reference; NOT smooth illustration and NOT coarse oversized blocks. Each row is four consecutive DISTINCT articulated poses, not a translated or resized duplicate. Rows in strict order: 1 idle breathing loop, 2 movement loop, 3 attack anticipation neutral-to-ready, 4 attack action, 5 recovery back to idle, 6 hurt recoil returning balance, 7 death buckle/fall to final inert corpse. No disappearance. Preserve character's identity in every frame. Rooted tall arched wood tree bell. Preserve ONE large gold bell hanging in open ivory-carved arch atop root trunk, turquoise drape, green leaves, spreading roots. Idle bell gently sways. Move is root-bound weight shift, roots stay planted, trunk bends slightly. Anticipation arch leans back and bell swings backwards progressively. Attack heavy bell swing front to back with sharp trunk flex and cloth response, no shockwave or particles. Recovery decreasing swing amplitude. Hurt arch twists and bell recoils. Death root base gives way, arch leans over then lays on ground with cracked but recognizable bell and drape. No disintegration.
